_about: 1-Butanol (1) + 1,4-Dioxane (2): isothermal total pressures at 363.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 1-butanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: B. S. Reddy, K. V. Rao, Measurement and correlation of binary vapor liquid equilibria of isomeric butanols with 1,4-dioxane, Fluid Phase Equilib. 264 (2008) 76-85
